key_insight: SWE-Serve benchmarks whether coding agents can make production-correct inference serving changes, not just pass local code tasks.
engineering_relevance: It targets real repository-level serving features across the inference stack, helping teams evaluate agent usefulness for production AI systems.
method: 53 repository-grounded tasks from recent SGLang production changes
Covers six inference engineering families on CPU or a single H100 GPU
Uses hidden functional/regression tests plus E2E serving tests and performance gates
evidence_signal: Across 11 models and 31 configurations, the best result reached 75% mean pass@1, while E2E tests rejected about one-third of patches that otherwise passed non-E2E checks.
watch_item: Because tasks are drawn from SGLang and rely on hidden tests and calibrated gates, results may not fully generalize to other serving stacks or deployment settings.
paper_title: SWE-Serve: Benchmarking Agentic Engineering For Production Inference Serving
